shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat/broad surface
circular or rosette-like motif (disc on A, rosette/palmette heads on B)
repeated motifs arranged in a vertical sequence
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow relief with round, radiating disc/rosette forms and repeated motifs running down the field, but that is about as generic as a correspondence can be. A depicts an anthropomorphic figure with headdress, arms and body ornaments carved on a three-dimensional block, while B is a flat panel with a purely vegetal scheme of a stem bearing alternating palmette/lotus-like flowers — different subject matter and different organizing logic.
